issues.title: Legacy modpack fails to start on newest OpenJDK 21
issues.workaround: Choose Java 17 for this game in Game settings.

issues.title: Corrupt mod file rejected during Smart Drop
issues.workaround: Re-download the mod JAR directly from Modrinth or CurseForge.

issues.title: Azure App Registration pending Minecraft Services access
issues.workaround: Use Offline Profile for local and offline-server play until Mojang approves Azure App ID.
